articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Video and Audio Streams
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring real-time reasoning over continuous video and audio inputs with significantly reduced latency compared to its predecessor. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on complex multi-step agentic benchmarks and introduces a new 'structured planning' mode designed for enterprise workflow automation. Pricing comes in at roughly 40% less per token than GPT-5 at launch, signaling aggressive commoditization of frontier capabilities.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Silver Medal Performance on International Math Olympiad 2026 Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved five of six problems from the 2026 IMO, achieving a score equivalent to a silver medal — a notable jump from last year's borderline-gold result by AlphaProof on the 2025 set. The system combines a refined neuro-symbolic search approach with a new self-verification module that prunes incorrect proof branches more aggressively. Researchers emphasize the advance in formal reasoning generalization rather than raw benchmark scores.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that approximately 500 Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots have been deployed across BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina and Amazon fulfillment centers in Texas for supervised logistics and assembly-assist tasks. The Gen 3 units feature redesigned actuators offering 30% greater payload capacity and a new on-device vision-language model enabling more flexible object manipulation. Both companies report promising early results but note the robots still require human oversight for edge-case handling.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Raises $1.5B Series C, Announces Partnership with Microsoft for Cloud-Connected Robot Intelligence
articles.summary: Figure closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $12 billion valuation, with participation from Microsoft, Intel Capital, and Bezos Expeditions. The accompanying Microsoft partnership will integrate Azure-hosted foundation models with Figure's humanoid robots, enabling over-the-air skill updates and centralized fleet learning across deployments. The company plans to scale production to 10,000 units by late 2027 with initial focus on manufacturing and logistics verticals.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Claude Architect' — an Autonomous Coding Agent That Can Manage Multi-Repo Codebases
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude Architect, an agentic coding system built on Claude 4 that can autonomously navigate, plan changes across, and submit pull requests in multi-repository enterprise codebases. Internal benchmarks show it resolves 64% of real-world GitHub issues end-to-end in monitored trials, up from approximately 40% with previous agentic approaches. The tool integrates with GitHub, GitLab, and Jira, and includes a human-in-the-loop approval workflow designed for production-grade engineering teams.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm Process Node, Promises 2x Density Over N2
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node has entered risk production at its Kaohsiung Fab 22, roughly on schedule for volume production in late 2027. The node uses second-generation gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery, promising approximately 2x transistor density over the N2 node while reducing power consumption by 25% at equivalent performance. Major customers including Apple, NVIDIA, and AMD are believed to have committed initial tape-out slots.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Fines Issued to Companies Deploying Prohibited Social Scoring Systems
articles.summary: The European Commission's new AI Office issued its first enforcement actions under the EU AI Act, levying fines totaling €38 million against two companies operating biometric-based social scoring and emotion recognition systems in workplace settings. The actions mark the first real regulatory teeth behind the Act's prohibited-use provisions that went into full effect in August 2026. Legal experts note the cases will set important precedents for how 'unacceptable risk' categories are interpreted across member states.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Maverick with 400B Parameters and a Mixture-of-Experts Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Maverick, a 400-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 16 active experts per forward pass, under a permissive open-source license. The model achieves performance competitive with GPT-5 on standard benchmarks while being deployable on a single 8xH100 node thanks to aggressive expert sparsity and 4-bit quantization support. The release includes fine-tuning recipes, RLHF datasets, and reference deployment code, further narrowing the gap between open and closed frontier models.
